verdict.rationale: GitLab's own materials position it as a source-control platform: 'from planning to source control to CI/CD… in one platform' and 'Work with the Git version control system.' A community report that commit email addresses are publicly visible implies commits are displayed. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents a web file browser, a commit-history view, or line-by-line blame. missing for 10: documented web repository file browser, documented web commit-history view, any evidence of line-by-line blame, independent hands-on corroboration of these UI views.
